title: The coefficient object is bounded constructible
statement: In [sk-def-sfb-dc-setting], the tensor unit of the derived category of Λ_X-module objects is bounded constructible for every ell-adic finiteness coefficient Λ.

source.place: Proposition 6.8.11(3); the unit part of the monoidal restricted-functor construction

proof.text: Identify the derived tensor unit with the single complex of the ordinary unit using the existing DerivedCategory.singleFunctorObjUnitIso theorem. It is concentrated in degree zero. Its degree-zero homology is the regular module, which is the cokernel of the zero map from the rank-zero to rank-one finite free module on the identity cover of the trivial stratification. In every other degree the homology is zero and admits a rank-zero presentation.
